key_source_files.purpose: defineShader DSL, props metadata, lowering, generator vs pointwise/gather filter
observations: defineShader aliases defineStd; object fields classify generator/filter/warp/shape/custom.
props include default, transform, ui, compileTime and recompile threshold rules.
WGSL gather filter lowers through defineRttFilter; generator lowers through lowerWgsl or fragment builder.

key_source_files.purpose: CompositionIR, multiple GPU passes and structural hash inputs
observations: CompositionIR has computeSteps, rttPasses in leaves-to-root order and final fullscreen canvas pass.
convertToTexture creates an RTT boundary; map-source cache avoids a duplicate boundary for one node/prop.
structural hash inputs include parent, revision, visible, mask, RTT, compile-time props and other composition structure.

key_source_files.purpose: device/root ownership, explicit WebGPU-only requirement, canvas context
observations: Default root promise is page-wide; injected GPUDevice is adopted via TypeGPU and cached per device.
Every renderer still configures its own HTMLCanvasElement context.
Cleanup must not destroy shared/injected device; callbacks are unsubscribed separately.
A lost injected device routes to the shared default WebGPU device; this is not WebGL fallback.

key_source_files.purpose: renderer shell, DOM dependencies, initialization, no WebGL path
observations: Requires HTMLCanvasElement; supports gpu device/adapter injection and observeElement=false.
initialize rejects context; getRendererType always returns webgpu even though return type retains webgl for source compatibility.
Renderer includes own RAF/frame loop, window pointer events, CSS/DOM measurements, sizing, canvas context and final output lifecycle.
Disabling observers skips ResizeObserver and IntersectionObserver, but is not proof of a worker/OffscreenCanvas or host-pass adapter.

key_source_files.purpose: plain-JS canvas API, custom definitions, update and lifecycle
observations: createShader(canvas,preset,options) builds a component registry; custom definitions may be supplied via options.components.
Passes options.gpu and observeElement to renderer.initialize while sizing via canvas style/getBoundingClientRect.
update sends known prop values to updateUniformValue; resize,pause,resume,destroy manage canvas renderer lifecycle.
Device-loss recovery is bounded in this wrapper; current preset shadow records updates for rebuilding.

observations.claim: Open source and free commercial software does not make Pro presets/sections/editor source all free/open.
A shader definition combines reusable effect role, props and GPU body, with editor metadata and compile-trigger information.
Components compose as a layer tree; compositor generates an ordered pass representation; pointwise analytic combination and RTT/compute coexist.
The selected runtime is WebGPU-only; no WebGL fallback is implemented. Transparent-canvas failure is host fallback behavior, not an alternate renderer.
Device injection and shared default device are real; canvas context/final output ownership remains in the renderer.
AI workflow supplies references, precise props, exports, previews/context and tracked source installation, rather than relying on free-form shader invention.

boundaries: Core engine and core renderer remain independently authored under the White Egret rule; do not copy this compositor, DSL compiler, runtime shell or shader implementation into first-party core.
Using an MIT third-party package would need explicit provenance, version/license notice and a dependency boundary; this task installs nothing.
Pro presets/sections are separately licensed creative content; do not convert their exports into White Egret's public component/preset library.
GPUDevice injection does not prove compatibility with White Egret's existing passes, render targets, depth/stencil, scheduling or final presentation ownership.
WebGL support would require independent backend/lowering/effect constraints or explicit capability degradation. WGSL translation alone does not prove every compute/RTT/media effect is portable.

No source-backed claim that Shaders can replace a game core renderer is warranted from this inspection; game batching, scene graph, texture atlas, text, skeletal animation, host-pass interop and target platform behavior were not evaluated.
Official performance estimates and marketing claims were not treated as benchmarks or White Egret performance evidence.
